title: Sexuality Education in Schools as First Line of Defence Against Sexual Violence
what_it_is: Sexuality Education in Schools as First Line of Defence Against Sexual Violence

sections.label: Sexual assault victim numbers
sections.summary: From 2017 to 2019, there were 7,483 victims of sexual assault.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan (Sengkang)
sentences.text: From 2017 to 2019, there were 7,483 victims of sexual assault.

sections.label: Workplace sexual harassment reporting survey
sections.summary: An AWARE Ipsos survey in November last year found only three in 10 survivors of workplace sexual harassment made official reports.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Recently, an AWARE Ipsos survey conducted in November last year found that only three in 10 survivors of workplace sexual harassment made official reports about their experiences.

sections.label: Minors assaulted by trusted people
sections.summary: Nearly nine out of 10 sexual assault cases involving minors are committed by someone they trust.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Nearly nine out of 10 sexual assault cases involving minors are committed by someone they trust.

sections.label: Classroom time on sexuality education
sections.summary: Students get just 25 hours of class time on sexuality education, equivalent to a week of school in 12 years.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Yet, when we break down how much classroom time is spent on sexuality education, we find that students get just 25 hours of class time on it.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan (Sengkang)
sentences.text: That is equivalent to a week of school in a total of 12 years of formal education.

sections.label: Parents' comfort with sexuality education
sections.summary: An AWARE survey last year found only 50% of parents surveyed were comfortable talking to their children about sexuality education.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan (Sengkang)
sentences.text: A survey by AWARE last year found that only 50% of parents surveyed were comfortable talking to their children about sexuality education.

sections.label: Educator training for sexuality education
sections.summary: Educators need to be more proactive in addressing sexual abuse and assault, and teachers must be trained in facilitation for effective sexuality education.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Educators, especially early childhood educators, need to be more proactive in sensing and addressing sexual abuse and assault.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Teachers must be trained in facilitation, especially in scenario and discussion-based learning, for sexuality education to be effective.

sections.label: School accountability and reporting channels
sections.summary: Schools need clear channels of accountability and reporting.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Our schools need clear channels of accountability and reporting.

sections.label: Calling out sexism and sexual violence
sections.summary: Everyone has a responsibility to call out sexism and respond to sexual violence so perpetrators are held accountable, and sexual education reform must be done urgently.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: Ms Khan, if you can wrap up, please.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan
sentences.text: We all have a responsibility to call out sexism, whether at the workplace or in public transport, and respond to incidents of sexual violence, so that perpetrators are held accountable.

sentences.speaker: Ms Raeesah Khan
sentences.text: Reforming our approach to sexual education has to be done soon and urgently to make Singapore a safe and nurturing place for all.

sections.label: Nurturing Early Learners Framework
sections.summary: The revised Nurturing Early Learners Framework for children aged four to six emphasises social and emotional competencies and includes body safety practices.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: The revised Nurturing Early Learners Framework, which covers children aged four to six, places a strong emphasis on the development of children's social and emotional competencies and include topics such as body safety practices.

sections.label: Updating sexuality education content
sections.summary: Content has been updated from the 2014 Sexuality Education curriculum to 2016 abuse protection enhancements and the CCE 2021 curriculum to remain relevant.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: From the roll-out of the Sexuality Education curriculum in 2014, to the enhancement of content on safety and protection from abuse in 2016 and the launch of the CCE 2021 curriculum this year, we have been updating our content to ensure that they remain relevant towards sexuality matters.

sections.label: Primary 1 personal safety lessons
sections.summary: From Primary 1, students learn about personal safety and protection from abuse.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: From as young as Primary 1, students learn about personal safety and protection from abuse.

sections.label: Autonomous Universities respect education modules
sections.summary: Autonomous Universities have implemented or are implementing compulsory modules on respect and appropriate behaviour, such as NUS teaching that consent must be actively communicated and given freely.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: The Autonomous Universities (AUs) have also implemented or are in the process of implementing compulsory education modules on respect and appropriate behaviour.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: For example, in NUS' education module, students learn that consent must be actively communicated and given freely and voluntarily.

sections.label: Singapore laws updated for tech crimes
sections.summary: Singapore's laws have been updated to reflect new societal issues such as tech-enabled crimes.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Sun Xueling)
sentences.text: The laws in Singapore have also been updated to reflect new societal issues and problems such as tech-enabled crimes.
